summary: The claim is FALSE: Wirecard AG was dissolved on 2020-09-03 and was under insolvency proceedings as of 2023-12-21, so it could not have published FY 2023 revenue.

findings.statement: Wirecard AG was dissolved on 2020-09-03, meaning it could not have existed to report FY 2023 revenue.
As of 2023-12-21, Wirecard AG was listed as participating in insolvency proceedings in Germany.
Due to its insolvency status, Wirecard AG did not publish or file financial statements for fiscal year 2023.
